subject: Swiggy integration offline - no orders received since 7:00 PM
description: The Swiggy integration on our POS terminal has gone offline. Since approximately 7:00 PM this evening, we have stopped receiving any online orders from the Swiggy platform. The POS system shows a connection error when attempting to sync with Swiggy. We have restarted the terminal once without success. Customer orders are being delayed and we need this resolved urgently as it is peak dinner service time.
